performance_targets: Sustained throughput target: 500 QPS (rerank workload, 50-token avg)
Peak burst handling: 2000 QPS for 60–120s windows without >10% latency degradation
Latency SLOs: p50 <40ms, p95 <120ms, p99 <250ms for inline reranking paths
Error budget: <1% transient failures during soak
Soak test plan: 14-day plan nominally, initial 2-week focused POC (48–72h stress + 10-day soak)
benchmark_plan: Stage 1 - Baseline: run 3 load profiles against 4xH100 cluster to collect kernel-level perf and KV cache hit rates (24h)
Stage 2 - Capacity sizing: test 8xH100 and 12xH100 configs to map QPS->GPU mapping and linearity (3 days)
Stage 3 - Soak: 72h steady run at 80% sustained load + scheduled 1-min spike every hour, measure memory growth and GC-like stalls (72h)
Stage 4 - Peak resilience: run 2k QPS 60s bursts at 0, 50, 90% baseline to validate autoscaling/fallbacks (1 day)
Stage 5 - Regression & quality: run representative prompt set (50k requests) and compare output quality vs baseline model; monitor for hallucination/regression
Stage 6 - Final: compile perf report, recommended reserved pool (GPU count, instance configs), and draft SLA appendix for procurement
